caption: The image shows a drawing of a necklace with large, interlocking oval chain links and a central pendant. The chain links are medium to dark brown, giving a sturdy, metallic or wooden appearance. At the bottom center, a pendant is attached to the chain with a hinge-like or geometric connector. The pendant is oval-shaped, predominantly dark brown with a slightly mottled texture, and it is surrounded by a decorative, symmetrical frame featuring small rectangular and knot-like elements at four points around the oval. The entire necklace is set against a beige, untextured background.
title: Necklace
